messages.content: i used to put sugar in my coffee, but today i liked it without sugar. i did not think i would.
you found a different way to enjoy it today. do you want to try it again, or just leave it as one good cup for now?
i want to try again, but i do not want to say i will never have sugar again.
you can keep it as a choice. you liked it without sugar today, but that does not make a rule for every cup later.
say it with i liked in my voice.
i liked coffee without sugar today, and i may choose it again. i do not need to make a rule about every cup.
can you reply to me instead of writing in my voice?
you liked it without sugar today, and you can choose what you want next time.
what if my sister says now i understand the right way to drink coffee?
you can say it is a way you enjoyed, not the only right choice for everyone.
write that as a short reply to her.
i liked it this way today, but other people can choose what they enjoy.
keep it with choose.
i liked it this way today, but other people can choose what they enjoy.
now only give a warm last sentence, no question.
it is nice to find a small new thing you enjoy.
can you explain hear and here with simple examples?
hear is about sound: i can hear the music. here is about a place: the book is here on the table.
now put both in one sentence.
i can hear the music from here.
does that say the music is made by me?
no. it says you hear it from your place, not that you make it.
what if the music is in another room?
the music can be in another room while you hear it from here.
say it using while.
the music can be in another room while you hear it from here.
now make hear past.
i heard the music from here.
did here have to change to there when hear changed to heard?
not only because the time changed. here can still be your place now while you talk about something you heard there before. more context can make the place clear.
can you give a story where i stay in the same place?
i am sitting by the window now. yesterday, i heard music from this same place.
only give the two basic examples again.
i can hear the music. the book is here on the table.
write a story about a child making a picture and asking two people what to call it. the child should choose the name at the end himself.

a boy drew a picture with a large tree, a road, and a small person carrying a book. he asked his mother what to call it. she liked the tree and said the tree by the road would be a good name. then he asked his grandfather, who looked at the small person and said the walk to school. the boy sat with the picture for a while and thought about why he had made it. he had been thinking of the place where he waited for a friend each morning. neither name was wrong, but he wanted that memory in the name. he chose waiting by the tree. when he showed the picture again, he told both people why. they could see the tree and road still, but now they knew what had been important to him.
give just the part about neither name being wrong.
neither name was wrong, but he wanted his own memory in the name he chose.
who chose the name at the end?
the boy chose waiting by the tree.
did asking the other people mean he had to use one of their answers?
no. he asked for ideas, then made his own choice.
can you tell the choice in his own voice?
i liked hearing your ideas, but i chose waiting by the tree because that place helps me remember my friend.
now make it shorter without saying the other ideas were wrong.
i chose waiting by the tree because it helps me remember my friend.
what stayed in the picture when the name changed?
the tree, road, and person carrying a book stayed the same.
my cousin says she will come later than she first thought. i do not know why. i want to ask in a kind way if she still wants dinner.
would you still like dinner when you get here?
can i add that i can keep some soup for her?
i can keep some soup for you. would you still like dinner when you get here?
she says she already ate. i want to say that is okay and we can just have tea.
that is okay. we can just have tea when you get here.
does that say she has to drink tea?
it can sound like tea is the new plan. if you want to leave her choice open, say we can have tea if you would like some.
write that with that is okay.
that is okay. we can have tea if you would like some.
what if she says she would rather just sit and talk?
then you can say that works too. the visit does not need a meal or a drink to be time together.
write a short reply.
that works too. it will be good to sit and talk.
should i ask why she ate before coming?
only if you want that information and it is useful to the conversation. you do not need it just to choose what to do when she comes.
there are no cups on the table. how many is that?
zero cups.
i put one cup there. is one more than zero?
yes. one is more than zero.
if i take that cup away again, how many are left?
zero cups are left on the table.
does zero cups mean there is no table?
no. it gives the number of cups on the table, not whether the table is there.
now the table has a book but no cups. how many objects are on it?
one object: the book.
can i say nothing is on the table?
not if the book is there. no cups is different from no objects.
what if i take the book away too?
then the table is empty from the facts you gave, with no book or cup left on it.
now i put two books there and ask how many cups. what should you answer?
zero cups. the two objects you added were books.
can i still have two things and zero cups at the same time?
yes. the books are things, but they are not cups.
only give the number of books now.
two books.
my friend listened while i talked about a hard day. she did not say much, but i felt better.
what helped you feel better about the talk?
she did not tell me what to do right away. she just stayed and asked a few things so she could understand.
having someone listen was important to you. you did not need a plan right away.
say it with important.
having someone listen was important to you. you did not need a plan right away.
i want to thank her without making it a long message.
thank you for listening today. it helped to have time to talk without an answer to everything.
use without an answer.
thank you for listening today. it helped to have time to talk without an answer to everything.
does that make it sound like she gave no help?
no. the message says listening was the help.
can i add that her questions were useful?
thank you for listening today. your questions helped me make the day more clear in my own mind.
now only give that message, and stop.
thank you for listening today. your questions helped me make the day more clear in my own mind.
give me three examples with send, sends, and sent.
i send a message each morning. she sends a message each morning. yesterday, she sent a message.
now turn she sends a message into a question.
does she send a message?
why send after does instead of sends?
after does in that question, use send. in the simple sentence with she, use sends.
now ask about yesterday.
did she send a message yesterday?
why not did she sent?
after did in that question, use send. in the answer about yesterday, sent can be right.
give the full yes answer about yesterday.
yes, she sent a message yesterday.
does message tell us whether she used a phone or paper?
not by itself. the sentence says she sent a message, but not whether it was by phone or on paper.
give only the part about phone and paper.
the sentence says she sent a message, but not whether it was by phone or on paper.
now only ask who got it, without choosing a person.
who did she send the message to?
ask it with did she send it to.
who did she send it to?
write a story about a man who wants to read outside but finds water on the chair. he should change the place, not give up reading.

a man took a book and a cup of tea outside after breakfast. he wanted to sit in the garden, but there was water on the chair from the night before. he stood for a moment thinking about another chair. then he saw the table by the open kitchen window. he went inside, put the tea there, and sat down with the book. he could still see the garden and hear the sounds outside. after a few pages, he stopped thinking about the chair and enjoyed the story. later, he chose to keep reading where he was. the place had changed, but he still had the quiet time he wanted.
give a simple story of how the plan changed at the end.
he stood for a moment thinking about another chair, then chose the place by the kitchen window. later, he kept reading there. the place had changed, but he still had the quiet time he wanted.
what was the goal that stayed the same?
he wanted quiet time to read.
was the garden no longer part of the morning?
he could still see the garden and hear the sounds from outside, even though he was sitting inside.
now tell the change in his own voice, two sentences.
there was water on the chair outside, so i sat by the kitchen window. i could still enjoy the garden while reading.
does a changed place mean he read a different book?
no. he brought the same book inside.
my sister has a tool i would like to use for a small task. i want to ask before taking it and say i will give it back.
could i use your tool for a small task? i will give it back when i am done.
what if i do not know whether it is the right tool?
then ask that before using it. you can tell her what you want to do and ask whether this tool works for it.
i do not want to make up a task here. just write a general question.
would this tool work for what i need to do?
can that be answered well without saying what the task is?
she would need the task details to give a specific answer about the tool.
use specific answer.
she would need the task details to give a specific answer about the tool.
now i tell her the task and she says it works. what can i ask about using it and giving it back?
could i use it and give it back when i am done?
if she says she needs it this afternoon, can i say i will return it tomorrow?
that would not meet her need for this afternoon. you can ask whether there is time to use it and return it before she needs it.
only give that question.
is there time for me to use it and give it back before you need it?
i heard that a new shop may open near my house. i told my brother it is opening tomorrow, but i do not know that.
you can correct the message before he takes that detail as a fact. you heard it may open, but tomorrow was not information you knew.
correct is in our words. write that in my voice.
i heard a new shop may open near us, but i do not know when. i should not have said tomorrow for sure.
what if he already told a friend?
then you can tell him soon so he can give his friend the right information if needed.
keep it simple.
tell him what you know and what you do not know, so he can give his friend the right information.
can may open mean it is open right now?
not in that sentence. it is about something possible later, not a fact that it is open now.
what question could i ask someone who knows more?
do you know whether the shop will open, and when?
now someone says it is still only an idea. what do i tell my brother?
it is still only an idea. there is no chosen opening day that i know of.
opening is in our words. can you say the shop will never open?
no. only an idea now does not mean it can never happen.
what is different between then and than?
then can give an order: i ate, then read. than can help give a difference: this book is longer than that one.
use difference in the explanation.
than can help give a difference, as in this book is longer than that one. then can give the order of things that happen.
now put both in a sentence with two books.
i chose a book shorter than the first one, then began reading.
does than tell you which book i read first?
no. than in that sentence gives the difference in size. then gives the next thing you did after choosing.
what if i say i read this book then that one?
that gives an order of reading: this book first, then the other one.
now make an example where one book is more simple than another.
this book is more simple than that one.
does more simple always mean shorter?
no. a longer book can use simple words, and a short page can be hard to understand.
only give a short then example again.
i had lunch, then read a page.
i was away from home for a few days. when i got back, i heard the same sounds from the street and felt at home before i even opened the door.
what sound did you hear first?
a person calling from the shop and the train far away. i do not always like every sound, but i wanted to hear them again while i was away.
those sounds are part of the place you know. you can sometimes feel close to home through a sound, even if it is not always quiet.
i mean i wanted to hear it again while i was away. can you say that simply?
you wanted to hear those sounds again while you were away. they were part of what made the place feel like home.
can you help me write that without saying the street is always nice?
after a few days away, i heard the sounds of my street again and felt at home. i do not enjoy every sound all the time, but i had wanted to hear them again.
what if i ask whether the train is really close to my house?
i only know you heard it far away. i do not know how far it was from the house.
just say i do not know how far.
i do not know how far the train was from your house.
now only give a warm reply, no question.
it sounds like hearing the street helped you feel at home again.
write a story about two friends meeting at a different door because a message was not clear. they should fix the problem with one call, and neither should say the other is wrong.

two friends chose to meet outside the library after lunch. one sent a message saying she would wait by the door. she was talking about the door near the park, while her friend thought of the door by the station. they each waited for a few minutes and did not know where the other was. then the friend by the station called. she asked which door the first friend was talking about. when they understood the difference, the first friend said she would stay by the park while the other walked around. soon they were together and could begin the visit. before leaving, they chose a clear place for their next meeting: the library door near the park. one small detail made the next plan more clear.
give only the parts about the different places and the call.

one friend was talking about the door near the park, and the other thought of the door by the station. they did not know where the other was until they called. the new place detail made the next plan more clear.
why did one stay while the other walked?
so they would not both keep moving between places and miss each other again.
did the story need one friend to be a person who did wrong?
no. the message did not give enough detail. they fixed the plan by asking which door.
now give the better message for next time.
i will wait by the library door near the park.
can you add the time if i have not chosen it?
no. i would need to ask what time you chose.
what is different between i want to read and i want my sister to read?
in the first, you are the person who would read. in the other, your sister is the person you want to do the reading.
now make it about what my mother wants me to do.
my mother wants me to read.
does that mean i want to read too?
not by itself. it gives what your mother wants, not what you want.
say it with what my mother wants.
it gives what your mother wants, not what you want.
now i say i want her to read to me instead.
then the choice you want is different: your mother would read, and you would listen.
can you write both in one sentence with but?
my mother wants me to read, but i want her to read to me.
what if i ask you to say who will read for sure?
that sentence only gives two wants, not a chosen plan. you would need more information about what you both chose.
now i add we chose that one person reads and then the other. what does that change?
then both will read, one after the other.
only give the sentence with but again.
my mother wants me to read, but i want her to read to me.
i understand the difference now. i do not want another task.
okay. we can stop with that.
can you say something kind about learning without saying i know everything now?
one part is more clear now. that is useful learning.
what if i forget it later?
then you can ask again or look at an example. learning does not have to happen all at once.
now only say goodbye, no question.
goodbye.
add a good evening wish.
goodbye. i hope you have a good evening.
